entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: [lName]-san... Honestly, I still[n]believe in the existence of fate.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I mean, the fortunes I see have an[n]extremely high accuracy rate.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: But... I suppose my divine power isn't[n]completely absolute, huh?
You're only realizing that now?
Do you want to test it again?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: It's not that... I just need some time to[n]accept that reality.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Well, of course... but I'm sure that would[n]only end in disappointment...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You know, I've wondered in the past[n]whether fate really can be changed...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: But I always concluded that it was[n]something beyond our control.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Almost like the laws of nature. Eternal...[n]Impossible to defy...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: And yet, there exist people like you[n]who can ignore those laws and impose[n]their own will upon the world...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: How can I become one of[n]those people, [lName]-san?
Strengthen your will.
I don't know.
Trust in yourself.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: My will... Do you mean to say I'm too[n]easily influenced by my own fortune telling?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I don't believe that for a second.[n]You seem to be very strong-willed...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Perhaps I'm too easily influenced by[n]my own fortune telling...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Trust in myself, instead of my fortune[n]telling? I've never thought of it that way[n]before!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: This city keeps finding ways[n]to subvert my expectations...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: There was nobody like you back[n]in my hometown in the country,[n][lName]-san.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: It was a small, traditional town deep[n]in the mountains, populated almost[n]entirely by older people...
Tell me more.
That sounds so peaceful.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: During the winter, it's practically[n]inaccessible due to all the snow.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: That alone should tell you volumes.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: The youth there are forced to be strictly[n]obedient to their elders as well. Not[n]explicitly, of course...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Oh, and there's a small shrine in[n]the center of the village. There, I...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...It doesn't matter anymore. I left that[n]place to come to this city.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: It means nothing to me now!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: After I arrived in Tokyo, I found comfort[n]in this stone.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: It came from someone who dared to care[n]about me, even though I'm just a monster[n]with strange powers...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: That's why I sell Holy Stones. I want to[n]help those who suffer from inescapable[n]fates similar to my own.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: But... now I wonder if they really do[n]much of anything.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: After all, you managed to change the[n]destinies of my clients without one.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Is it truly possible to alter fate with[n]nothing more than mere words,[n]attitude, and passion?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: If that's the case, I won't be needing this.[n]I'm going to confront fate head-on, with[n]my own strength.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Although... the chairman would be really[n]mad if he found out.
...The chairman?
I'm not sure I follow.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: O-Oh, don't worry about that! Just forget[n]about it... unless you want to suffer my[n]curse, that is.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Anyway...! If fate can be changed...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Maybe even mine can be corrected...[n]right? It didn't work for me before,[n]but perhaps this time...
I think it'll work.
It all depends on you.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: R-Right!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I look forward to our continued exchange![n]At least, until I can manage to change[n]my fate...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Oh, and I'll be sure to put some extra[n]effort into my fortune telling for you!
I can sense Chihaya's[n]intense motivation...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Thank you for today, [lName]-san.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Good night.
